proof_summary: The counterexample is \(N=28996592704045424640=2^{13}3^6 5\,7^6 13^4 17^2\); multiplicativity of the divisor sum gives \(\sigma(N)=140078688585537333726=2\cdot3^2\cdot29\cdot43\cdot127\cdot307\cdot1093\cdot4733\cdot30941\). Replacing each prime factor \(p\) of this value by \(p-1\) (with multiplicity) yields exactly \(N\), so \(N\) is a positive fixed point absent from the proposed list.
